evidence_items.explanation: The paper reports 92.9% GSM8K accuracy for baseline Code Interpreter and 97.0% with verification and voting. This is material evidence against a sweeping claim of poor elementary-word-problem performance, but it does not establish reliability across scientific problems or Wolfram Alpha.

evidence_items.explanation: The repeated-trial study found uneven Code Interpreter accuracy, while its easiest problems were solved in every reported trial and consensus answers succeeded on all 13 problems. Its college engineering scope and lack of Wolfram Alpha testing prevent direct resolution of the broader simple-problem claim.
